introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: Answer ALL the questions in the spaces provided (15 questions); the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: Answer ALL FOUR questions in this section; all questions in Section B carry equal marks (15 marks each). You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Duration: two and a half hours.
enonce_intro_markdown: Given the points $O$, $A$ and $B$ with coordinates $(0,0)$, $(5,0)$ and $(1,4)$ respectively.

questions.corrige_markdown:
$O$ is the origin, so the position vector of $B$ is its coordinates:

**$\overrightarrow{OB}=\begin{pmatrix}1\\4\end{pmatrix}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) $\overrightarrow{OM}$, where $M$ is the midpoint of $\overrightarrow{AB}$. *[6 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Method 1: $M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $\overrightarrow{OM}=\dfrac12\left(\overrightarrow{OA}+\overrightarrow{OB}\right)=\dfrac12\begin{pmatrix}6\\4\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}3\\2\end{pmatrix}$.

Method 2: $M=\left(\dfrac{5+1}{2},\dfrac{0+4}{2}\right)=(3,2)$, so $\overrightarrow{OM}=\begin{pmatrix}3\\2\end{pmatrix}$.

**$\overrightarrow{OM}=\begin{pmatrix}3\\2\end{pmatrix}$.**
